summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 16, 2026 share transfer agreement with A to Co., Ltd. and Masato Takao to acquire 100% of A TO SPORTS INC., a British Columbia children's soccer school operator, for JPY2,000,000 (about US$13,040) cash. The LEIFRAS board approved the deal, expected effective January 1, 2027. Closing conditions include target shareholder/board approval, officer-loan waiver, a key-man agreement, and customary documents. The agreement includes a five-year key-man service covenant and five-year non-compete. Watch regulatory and closing-condition risk given the nominal price.
